text: Piening died in Kiel.
quote: He died in Kiel on 15 May 1984 .

text: Piening joined the Reichsmarine.
quote: Piening joined the Reichsmarine in 1930

subject: self
text: Piening reached the rank of Kapitänleutnant.
quote: reaching the rank of Kapitänleutnant by April 1939

subject: self
text: Piening moved from the surface fleet to the U-boat arm.
quote: In October 1940 he moved from the surface fleet to the U-boat arm

subject: self
text: Piening carried out a single patrol out of Saint-Nazaire as Kommandantenschüler.
quote: In May–June 1941 he carried out a single patrol out of Saint-Nazaire

subject: self
text: Piening was appointed commander of the newly built Type IX submarine.
quote: he was appointed commander of the newly built Type IX submarine on 23 August 1941

subject: self
text: Piening set out from Kiel on his first patrol in command of U-155.
quote: Piening set out from Kiel on his first patrol in command of U-155 in February 1942

subject: self
text: Piening became well known for developing the Piening Route.
quote: He also became well known for developing the Piening Route in 1943

subject: part_of_self
text: U-155 attacked and sank MS Siranger.
quote: U-155 attacked and sank MS Siranger , sailing from New York to West-Africa , on 24 October 1943

subject: self
text: Piening left U-155.
quote: In March 1944 Piening left U-155

subject: self
text: Piening was appointed commander of the 7th U-boat Flotilla at Saint-Nazaire.
quote: In March 1944 Piening left U-155 and was appointed commander of the 7th U-boat Flotilla at Saint-Nazaire

subject: self
text: Piening made one last patrol, laying mines off Saint-Nazaire.
quote: In April 1945 Piening made one last patrol , laying mines off Saint-Nazaire

subject: self
text: Piening joined the new Bundesmarine navy.
quote: In 1956 , West Germany established its navy , the Bundesmarine , and Piening joined the new navy .

subject: self
text: Piening was appointed commanding officer of the 1. Geleitgeschwader (1st Escort Squadron).
quote: In 1959 he was appointed commanding officer of the 1 . Geleitgeschwader ( 1st Escort Squadron ) .

subject: self
text: Piening became team leader at the Führungsakademie der Bundeswehr.
quote: On 1 October 1965 he became team leader at the Führungsakademie der Bundeswehr , serving until 1969
